description: Developing responsive and user-friendly web applications using React.js, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS. Building reusable UI components, integrating REST APIs, optimizing performance, and ensuring cross-browser compatibility.

Built responsive web applications using React.js, JSX, functional components, React Hooks, and React Router. Gained hands-on experience in component-based architecture and modern frontend development.
Developed a Real Estate Property Selling Website and an AI-Powered Stock Market Intelligence Dashboard with responsive layouts, interactive UI, and reusable React components.
